registryCustodian: Bayelsa Geographic Information System (BGIS), under the Bayelsa State Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Ijaw/Izon-oriented discovery queries were executed. English first-party discovery identified BGIS and the Bayelsa Ministry of Lands; the local-language-oriented query found no distinct official Ijaw-language cadastral endpoint. Full queries, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-6682-amassoma.json.
requestOutcomes: Official BGIS home, services, about page, public WordPress page JSON, Bayelsa Ministry of Lands site, and Bayelsa Judiciary context page were retrieved with ordinary anonymous GETs. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used. No viewer JavaScript/configuration, parcel schema, CRS, native parcel ID, bounded geometry, or citywide parcel response was obtained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [4.97495916542313, 6.10771354552521] was preserved and not moved to force a parcel hit.
No exact-point lookup or map-extent conclusion was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
The official state GIS lead establishes a state custodian, not a verified anonymous citywide parcel-vector feed for Amassoma.
No parcel polygon or source-specific raw attribute set is retained.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: A relevant Bayelsa state cadastral custodian and official public GIS lead were evidenced, but no anonymous public parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or citywide open coverage was qualified.

uncertainty: The public BGIS site may front additional land-information workflows not exposed in the inspected anonymous pages. This unresolved endpoint is recorded as unavailable evidence, not as proof that Amassoma lacks cadastral parcels.
